description: This source file implements quantized embedding bag operations for CPU, including fallback implementations, specific handling for 8-bit, 4-bit, and 2-bit quantization, and integration with FBGEMM library for optimized routines. It defines functions for byte and bit-width specific embedding lookups, helpers for packed weights, and registration of these operators within the PyTorch framework.
